source_issue.title: Add Plone documentation to sites that attract first-time contributors

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue aims to enhance Plone's documentation to attract first-time contributors. It’s part of a pilot program modeled after successful initiatives, enabling new users to start contributing easily.

## What needs to be done
1. Update Plone documentation to reflect this pilot program.
2. Identify and address any aspects that might make new contributors feel unwelcome.
3. Consider adding options for non-code contributions, like translations or technical writing.

## Helpful background
The issue has discussions regarding acceptance into platforms like Up For Grabs and Good First Issue, although the status with Good First Issue is currently unclear. Input from first-time contributors has revealed a need for welcoming and accessible documentation, especially given recent changes in the Plone community and event management like Hacktoberfest.

## Good first steps
1. Review the existing [first-time contributor documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/first-time.html).
2. Note any barriers or areas for improvement you find.
3. Engage in discussion here if you have questions, or reach out to contributors for guidance!
